_comment: Agency brain - TF-IDF index built from these entries by apt_knowledge. Add your real FAQs, your real guarantees, your real prices. Everything here is used as context by every other agent, so keeping it honest keeps every agent honest.

entries.title: Basic package price and contents
entries.body: Basic package: 15,000 PKR (ya 1,500 PKR mahine). Is mein 5 pages, mobile responsive design, WhatsApp button, contact form, Google Map embed aur basic SEO shamil hain. Delivery 7 din. Best for chhoti shop ya single-location business.

entries.title: Recommended package price and contents
entries.body: Recommended package: 35,000 PKR (ya 3,000 PKR mahine). 10 pages, custom design, WhatsApp aur call buttons, SEO setup, speed optimisation, Google Business setup, 3 mahine support, analytics. Delivery 10 din. Sab se zyada chuna jata hai restaurants, clinics aur salons ke liye.

entries.title: Premium package price and contents
entries.body: Premium package: 75,000 PKR (ya 6,000 PKR mahine). Unlimited pages, e-commerce ya booking engine, payment gateway, custom admin panel, copywriting, photography guidance, 12 mahine support, priority response. Delivery 21 din. Multi-branch aur e-commerce ke liye.

entries.title: Monthly payment option
entries.body: Har package monthly option ke sath aata hai: chhoti monthly fee + hosting. Koi bara upfront nahi. Client kabhi bhi rok sakta hai. Ye option tab dete hain jab client kehta hai 'abhi itne paise nahi hain'.

entries.title: Add-on prices
entries.body: Add-ons: logo design 5,000; content writing 10 pages 8,000; local SEO 3 mahine 12,000; Google Business Profile setup 3,000; social media kit 4,000; domain + hosting 1 saal 6,000 PKR.

entries.title: Free mockup / trial policy
entries.body: Build-first approach: pehle client ki site ka free homepage mockup banate hain (24 ghante mein), pasand aaye tab payment. 7 din ki money-back guarantee. Advance sirf 50%, baqi delivery par. Source code client ki property hota hai.

entries.title: Payment terms and methods
entries.body: 50% advance, 50% delivery par. Payment methods: bank transfer, JazzCash, EasyPaisa. Monthly option bhi available hai. Invoice aur written scope har project ke sath milta hai.

entries.title: What we guarantee
entries.body: Guarantees: mobile-friendly har phone pe, 7 din ke andar delivery ya paisay wapas, source code client ki property, client khud edits karna seekh jata hai (free training), aur 3 mahine tak free WhatsApp/Live chat support.

entries.title: How a project runs
entries.body: Process: (1) free audit ya discovery call, (2) written brief aur scope, (3) free mockup 24 ghante, (4) 50% advance, (5) design approval, (6) development, (7) content aur photos, (8) testing mobile pe, (9) launch + Google submission, (10) training session, (11) 3 mahine support.

entries.title: Local SEO what we actually do
entries.body: Local SEO mein: Google Business Profile optimize, NAP consistency, LocalBusiness schema, page speed, mobile-first, local keywords ('restaurant near me', 'dentist in Gulshan'), reviews strategy, aur monthly reporting. Ranking ka koi jhoota wada nahi - sirf measurable kaam.

entries.title: Why mobile-first matters in Pakistan
entries.body: Pakistan mein 80% se zyada traffic mobile se aata hai. Agar site mobile pe theek nahi khulti to customer 3 second mein chala jata hai. Har site mobile-first banate hain: viewport meta, responsive CSS, bari tap targets, aur 3 second se kam load time 3G pe.

entries.title: Why every site needs a WhatsApp button
entries.body: Pakistan mein sab se aasan conversion WhatsApp hai. Ek tap se customer aap ko direct message kar sake - ye email form se 5x zyada kaam karta hai. Har package mein WhatsApp button shamil hai, aur click-to-chat link wa.me format mein hota hai.

entries.title: Case study: Karachi Biryani House
entries.body: Karachi Biryani House: menu PDF tha jo phone pe nahi khulta tha. Hum ne mobile menu + WhatsApp order button banaya. Result: 3 mahine mein online orders 40% barh gaye aur Foodpanda commission bachne laga.

entries.title: Case study: Dr Ayesha Dental Clinic
entries.body: Dr Ayesha Dental Clinic, Lahore: appointment sirf phone par hoti thi. Online booking form + timings page banaya. Result: appointment bookings double, aur phone calls 35% kam - staff ka waqt bach gaya.

entries.title: Case study: Glamour Salon Islamabad
entries.body: Glamour Salon, Islamabad: sirf Instagram tha. Local SEO + website banayi. Result: 'salon near me' search mein #1 local rank, aur 60% naye clients Google se aane lage.

entries.title: How long does a website take
entries.body: Landing page 3 din, business site 7 din, recommended package 10 din, premium/ecommerce 21 din. Ye tab hai jab content aur photos waqt par mil jayein. Free mockup 24 ghante mein milta hai.

entries.title: Can I edit the site myself
entries.body: Haan. Har project mein training session shamil hai - aap khud text, photos aur prices update karna seekh jate hain. Premium mein custom admin panel bhi hota hai. Phir bhi aap chahein to maintenance plan le sakte hain.

entries.title: Domain and hosting
entries.body: Domain + hosting 1 saal 6,000 PKR. Client ka domain client ke naam par hota hai - hum kabhi bhi aap ki property apne naam nahi karte. Business email bhi setup kar dete hain (info@aapkabusiness.com).

entries.title: E-commerce and payments
entries.body: E-commerce mein: product catalogue, cart, checkout, JazzCash/EasyPaisa/Stripe integration, COD option, order management panel aur inventory. Delivery 21 din. Payment gateway ke liye client ka business bank account chahiye.

entries.title: After delivery support
entries.body: Har project ke sath 3 mahine free support (recommended aur premium mein 12 mahine). Is ke baad maintenance plan 1,500 se 6,000 PKR mahine. Support mein: backups, security updates, chhoti changes, aur uptime monitoring.

entries.title: Script when client says too expensive
entries.body: Mehnga hai sun kar: pehle tiered options do (Basic/Recommended/Premium), phir monthly option, phir ROI (2 extra orders = site ki qeemat), phir free mockup. Kabhi bhi price kam na karo bina value kam kiye - is se aap ki quality par shak hota hai.

entries.title: Script when client already has a site
entries.body: Meri site pehle se hai: audit ke 3 specific issues batao (score, TTFB, mobile viewport), har issue ke sath business nuksan batao. Kehna: 'aap ki site banwane ki zarurat nahi, sirf ye 2 cheezein theek karni hain'.

entries.title: Script when client asks who are you
entries.body: Aap kaun hain: naam, shehar, saal, ek portfolio example with measurable result, client reference offer, aur free audit report jo wo khud verify kar sake. Risk kam karo: free mockup, 50% advance, 7 din refund, source code un ke naam.

entries.title: Rules for first contact messages
entries.body: Kabhi 'We build websites' se shuru mat karo. Hamesha un ki site ke ek specific audit finding se shuru karo. Business ka naam lazmi. Ek sawaal ke sath khatam karo. WhatsApp 100 words se kam, email 200 words se kam. Roz max 20 messages.

entries.title: Rules for follow-ups
entries.body: Har follow-up mein naya value lazmi hai: naya audit finding, naya portfolio piece, naya insight, ya free mockup. 'Just checking in' kabhi nahi. Schedule: 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, 23 din. 5 touch se kam mein mat haaro.

entries.title: How to write in Roman Urdu
entries.body: Client ki language match karo. Roman Urdu mein chhote jumle, 'aap' ka istemal, English technical terms waise hi (WhatsApp, website, SEO). Zyada formal mat bano - 'Salam' acha hai, 'Dear Sir' nahi. Har message mein ek hi kaam manga jaye.

entries.title: Pakistani SME reality
entries.body: Pakistani SME: budget 15,000 se 75,000 PKR, decision maker aksar owner khud hota hai, WhatsApp sab se tez channel hai, trust sab se bari rukawat hai. Advance payment se ghabrate hain - is liye build-first aur 50% advance ka model chalta hai.
